newsitem.title: USA: Aerovox sees less than expected Q2 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Aerovox sees less than expected Q2 earnings.

text.p: Aerovox Inc said Thursday that its earnings for the second quarter will be less than it expected.
"The quarter will be profitable, but not to the extent we had expected," the company said.

It said further strengthening of the pound sterling forced it to cut deeper into margins in an effort to stay competitive at key European customers. Additionally, the company said an unusually cool spring and early summer in the Northeast caused customers to push back and cancel orders in its North American room air conditioning market.
The company said it will release second quarter earnings July 21.
